episodes.name: Moon Girl Landing
episodes.overviewEn: When brilliant, altruistic Lunella Lafayette accidentally brings a dinosaur to the Lower East Side, she finally has the brawn to match her brains and protect her community.

episodes.name: The Borough Bully
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella finds a nasty comment on her Moon Girl social media page, her fixation on the troll threatens to take over her life.

episodes.name: Run the Rink
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella runs the rink for a night, she agrees to Casey's get-rich-quick scheme, which threatens Moon Girl’s reputation and her family's beloved business.

episodes.name: Check Yourself
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella loses a game of chess against a supercomputer, her obsession with winning drives the frustrated computer to program every device in the school to attack her.

episodes.name: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella creates a chemical to change her hair, she accidentally turns her mane into a vengeful villain that vows to ruin her.

episodes.name: The Beyonder
episodes.overviewEn: The Beyonder gloms onto Lunella to learn about humanity, just as she's struggling to win a big science competition.

episodes.name: Moon Girl's Day Off
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella seemingly gets hurt and is stuck in bed, Casey must step in as Moon Girl for the day.

episodes.name: Teacher's Pet
episodes.overviewEn: When Devil Dinosaur gets jealous of sharing Lunella with her class hamster and accidentally sets the animal free, he must search New York City to bring the furry friend home.

episodes.name: Skip This Ad…olesence
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella creates a device that allows her to fast forward through mundane chores and tasks, but she struggles to handle the unexpected side effects.

episodes.name: Goodnight, Moon Girl
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella tries to overcome her awkwardness about fitting in at a slumber party by creating a mind-reading device but accidentally switches brains with Devil Dinosaur.

episodes.name: Like Mother, Like Moon Girl
episodes.overviewEn: Moon Girl fights to save the LES from changing.

episodes.name: Today, I Am a Woman
episodes.overviewEn: Hoping to help Casey have an epic bat mitzvah, Lunella makes an appearance as Moon Girl, which ultimately brings out the worst in Casey and causes a rift in their friendship.

episodes.name: Devil on Her Shoulder
episodes.overviewEn: Feeling insecure about his size, Devil convinces Lunella to create a potion to make him temporarily small.

episodes.name: Coney Island, Baby!
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella must confront her childhood fear, the Coney Island Funhouse, to save Mimi from The Beyonder.

episodes.name: "OMG Issue #1"
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella uncovers the history of the Original Moon Girl as she struggles to thwart a powerful villain's plan to use her portal for evil.

episodes.name: "OMG Issue #2"
episodes.overviewEn: Moon Girl faces her greatest challenge yet and puts everything on the line.

episodes.name: The Great Beyond-Er!
episodes.overviewEn: When Moon Girl and The Beyonder become stranded on a desolate alien planet, the two set out to find a rumored black hole in hopes of getting home.

episodes.name: Suit Up!
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella tries to juice up her new super suit, she goes overboard and accidentally 'juices up' a dangerous desert scorpion.

episodes.name: Belly of the Beast
episodes.overviewEn: When Devil Dinosaur eats a dangerous Moon Girl gadget, Lunella and Casey must shrink themselves to retrieve it.

episodes.name: Ride or Die
episodes.overviewEn: When Moon Girl must transport Quickwhip to S.H.I.E.L.D., keeping the criminal in custody becomes harder than she imagined.

episodes.name: Kid Kree
episodes.overviewEn: Moon Girl’s rivalry with a new teenage super-foe, Kid Kree, threatens her budding friendship with his human alter ego, Marvin.

episodes.name: Wish-Tar
episodes.overviewEn: When The Beyonder gives an arcade machine the ability to grant wishes, Lunella is pumped to use it.

episodes.name: Make It, Don't Break It!
episodes.overviewEn: When I.S. 833 gets an impressive science teacher, Lunella is so eager to impress her that her drive toward perfectionism starts doing more harm than good.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella and Devil Dinosaur spend the weekend apart after a disagreement, Devil Dino gets mixed up with a rag-tag group of ex-Super Hero sidekicks.

episodes.name: In the Heist
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella discovers that a stolen Kree artifact is about to cause a cataclysmic storm, but when none of the adults believe her, she must swipe it herself.

episodes.name: Dog Day Mid-Afternoon
episodes.overviewEn: When Pops fosters a mysterious stray dog and enters him into a dog show, a paranoid Lunella is convinced the creature is an evil alien who intends to sabotage the event.

episodes.name: Roller Jam!
episodes.overviewEn: When Pops' rivalry with former best friend and skate partner Vernell threatens to ruin Roller Jam, Lunella meddles in their beef to squash it.

episodes.name: Dancing with Myself
episodes.overviewEn: Lunella is desperate to find a date to the school dance, but when she gets Kid Kree to be her escort, she learns that peer pressure can harm the relationships that matter most.

episodes.name: Family Matters
episodes.overviewEn: When Moon Girl teams up with the amazing Super Hero, Turbo, she realizes the true cost of keeping up a secret identity.

episodes.name: The Molecular Level
episodes.overviewEn: After Lunella tells her family that she's Moon Girl, she must convince them she will be safe, which seems impossible when Molecule Man shows up for revenge.

episodes.name: Moon Girl, Grounded
episodes.overviewEn: When Adria forbids Lunella from Moon Girl-ing, Lu must figure out how to defend the LES from a villainous crew, the Felonious Four.

episodes.name: Ride Along
episodes.overviewEn: Eager to bond with her dad, Moon Girl takes James on a ride-along.

episodes.name: Lava Actually
episodes.overviewEn: When being around the brilliant Hot Tomatoes leaves Pops feeling insecure, he dabbles in an elixir that makes him smart.

episodes.name: Full Moon
episodes.overviewEn: Adria plans a special mother-daughter bonding day with Lunella.

episodes.name: To Intervention and Beyond-er
episodes.overviewEn: Devil Girl instigates a friendship intervention between Moon Girl and The Beyonder, but emotional frustrations push the trickster’s powers to fritz.

episodes.name: Crushed
episodes.overviewEn: When Lunella discovers that Eduardo has a crush on her, she creates a fake boyfriend to spare his feelings.

episodes.name: A Devil-ish Birthday
episodes.overviewEn: Devil Dinosaur gets two birthday parties.

episodes.name: Party Girl
episodes.overviewEn: Moon Girl gets into the children's party business.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
episodes.overviewEn: The Beyonder comes to dinner.

episodes.name: Shoot for the Moon
episodes.overviewEn: Moon Girl must make a life-changing decision.
